searched: Retrieved 29 October 2026, sequentially, direct route only. BAAI: www.baai.ac.cn is now a single-page application; its home page and the former pages www.baai.ac.cn/news/beijing-ai-principles.html, www.baai.ac.cn/blog/beijing-ai-principles and www.baai.ac.cn/portal/article/index/type/center_result/id/110.html (the Beijing AI Principles) all return HTTP 200 with the same empty JavaScript shell, so the site's text was read from its script file (assets/index-hCeadbk4.js) and one page of its news API (/api/news, whose items link to WeChat posts and carry re-import dates, so it was not used as evidence). BAAI Community (hub.baai.ac.cn) posts 4041 (second anniversary), 8375 (Wu Dao 2.0, 2021 conference), 2197 (Principles for Children) and 27398 (Wu Dao 3.0, 2023 conference; a repost of a media article, not used) were read. 2021.baai.ac.cn has no Wu Dao text. The Chinese text of the Beijing AI Principles (2019) was not found on any BAAI page; www.linking-ai-principles.org/cnprinciples failed (expired TLS certificate, then connection reset; no HTTP status); the English text was taken from ai-ethics-and-governance.institute, and the co-publishers from China Daily (reporting); Beijing News (bjnews.com.cn, 26 May 2019) was read but gives only a summary. No statement of BAAI's registered legal form (e.g. 民办非企业单位) was found; a web search found none, and registry aggregators were not used. BAAI's hosting of the International Dialogues on AI Safety (its timeline: 北京AI安全国际对话举办, March 2024; idais-beijing.baai.ac.cn) was not recorded: hosting is not authorship and the statement was not drafted. Wu Dao 1.0 (20 March 2021) has no record of its own because only the 2021 conference post mentions it; Wu Dao 3.0 and later BAAI models (Emu3.5, the 悟界 series, RoboBrain) were left out for budget. Hugging Face: commit lists and READMEs for BAAI/Aquila-7B (three pages of commits; earliest 8 June 2023), BAAI/Emu3-Gen and BAAI/bge-large-zh-v1.5; arXiv PDFs and abstract pages for 2307.05222, 2409.18869, 2309.07597 and 2408.07410 (v1). Authorship records for Huang Tiejun (Emu, 2307.05222) and Wang Zhongyuan were not drafted, since neither is in existing-entities. Shanghai AI Laboratory: www.shlab.org.cn home page (first connection reset, then HTTP 200) and /aboutus (gives no founding date; describes itself as 新型科研机构); no founding date was found on a laboratory or government page, so the unveiling of 11 July 2020 rests on Yicai; chinanews.com.cn/gn/2021/05-14/9476944.shtml (HTTP 200) did not yield the article body in the text layer and was not used; two touch.shio.gov.cn pages were unrelated. No laboratory or filing text naming its legal entity (上海人工智能创新中心) was found; the CAC lists are left to the governance group. GitHub InternLM/InternLM was read through a blobless clone for commit history and raw.githubusercontent.com for the initial README; Hugging Face commit lists and files for internlm/internlm2-chat-7b (README first created 15 January 2024; the initial weights commit has no README, HTTP 404), internlm/Intern-S1 and OpenGVLab/InternVL-Chat-V1-5 (commit list only; its licence was not drafted); arXiv PDFs and abstract pages for 2403.17297, 2312.14238, 2508.15763, 2507.18576 and 2507.16534 (v1). Zhou Bowen's authorship is recorded only where the report names him as Scientific Director; his place in the long Intern-S1 author list was not drafted. Existing records reused: Zhou Bowen's role from April 2024 and the Frontier AI Risk Management Framework v1.0 records. web.archive.org was not used.
